Did you compile the engine yourself or use a third-party build? (If so, please link to the build here.) Official Godot binaries are not compiled using Clang/LLVM.

Also, how much RAM do you have on the system?

No,I downloaded the engine on your official website.When I download the 4.3stable-x64 version and run it,the window open and exit itself about 2 second later(I tried to run the console_version engine,and it showed the error:"LLVM Error:out of memory"on the command).But when I download 4.3stable-win32 version,it can run successfully.
my CPU:Intel Pentium Gold G5420
my GPU:Intel UHD 610 Graphics
    What's more,when I edit my project with the win32 version engine,when I was using the VisualShader,I found a bug:when I tried to link two blocks(for example:a ColorConstant and the export block),the two blocks disappeared

I suspect the LLVM error here orginates in the GPU driver. At least AMD drivers are using LLVM on Linux, they might too on Windows.
